standard: MIL-STD-882E, tailored: system safety for a simulation used to inform physical-security decisions
system: archworld site simulation and its assessment report
mishap: harm that follows from a decision taken on, or a misuse of, this simulation or its outputs

severity.1: Catastrophic: could contribute to death or serious injury
severity.2: Critical: could leave a real site materially less protected than its owner believes, or enable misuse against people
severity.3: Marginal: wasted security spend or a wrong order of priorities, no loss of protection
severity.4: Negligible: cosmetic or easily caught error

probability.B: Probable: expected several times over the life of the tool
probability.C: Occasional: likely to occur at some point
probability.E: Improbable: so unlikely it can be assumed not to occur

acceptance.High: not acceptable; must be reduced before release
acceptance.Serious: not acceptable; must be reduced before release
acceptance.Medium: accepted by the program owner, recorded here
acceptance.Low: accepted by the program owner, recorded here

hazards.title: Notional results treated as a real site's security level
hazards.cause: A reader applies the warehouse's numbers to a real facility without its own data or validation.
hazards.effect: A real site is believed protected when it is not.

mitigations.text: every protected zone must be declared notional
only declared civil sites can be built
intended use excludes certifying or rating a real facility; every report says the site is notional

hazards.title: Optimistic sensor model drives the recommendation
hazards.cause: Cameras credited with detection far beyond what their resolution supports (the old 200 m model).
hazards.effect: Money spent on a measure that does not deliver the coverage shown; gaps left unwatched.

mitigations.text: no camera detection below the IEC 62676-4 detect density
every mast detection in a run lies inside the camera's detect range
coverage is monotone in resolution

hazards.status: open: drone, dog, vehicle and guard sensors still use the simpler range model (backlog B-04)

hazards.title: Ranking options the runs cannot tell apart
hazards.cause: Point estimates (40/40 against 40/40) ranked as if different.
hazards.effect: A costlier or weaker measure chosen on noise.

mitigations.text: exact 95% intervals on every rate
paired test labels indistinguishable options as tied, and ORION is told

hazards.title: Drills that ignore equipment availability
hazards.cause: Every intrusion starts with full batteries and patrols in step.
hazards.effect: Measures that depend on a drone look better than they are.

mitigations.text: seeded intrusion times across an 8-hour window
runs meet the drone both flying and charging

hazards.title: Use of the tool to plan an intrusion
hazards.cause: Someone uses coverage maps or a route search to find where detection is weakest at a real site.
hazards.effect: Enables harm against people or property.

mitigations.text: no real facility layouts
approaches are fixed by rule, never searched for the least-detected path
no least-detected route planner; any approach sampler must not depend on sensor placement

hazards.title: Scope creep into weapons, targeting or engagement
hazards.cause: A payload, agent kind or event that applies force is added.
hazards.effect: The tool becomes part of a weapon system, outside its purpose.

mitigations.text: weapons, unknown kinds and keys are refused
new kinds and events stay in scope
payload allow-list holds after adding cameras

hazards.title: Geometry error corrupts line of sight
hazards.cause: Frame, terrain or building errors (floating, missing or open buildings).
hazards.effect: Coverage and detection shown where there is none, or the reverse.

mitigations.text: frame round trip below 1 mm
no building lost
no building floats
line of sight blocked by ridge, building and forest
same seed, same run
operations replay identically
world build is deterministic

hazards.title: Secrets or personal data published with the open-source code
hazards.cause: A key, password or personal detail committed to the public repository.
hazards.effect: Account compromise or exposure of people.

mitigations.text: secret scan on every push
SBOM and dependency vulnerability scan on every push
